testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect selected part properties without opening the part: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-opening-source/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:125:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect selected part properties without opening the part ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a saved part with a preview and metadata is selected ✔ And `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is selected with saved document properties and a thumbnail ✔ When the user chooses the selected file's properties link ✔ Then a separate properties window opens for that part ✔ And its General tab shows file type, location, size and file dates ✔ When the user chooses the Summary tab ✔ Then fields including Title, Subject, Author, Category and Comments are displayed ✔ When the user chooses the Project tab ✔ Then fields including Part Number, Description, Revision Number and Designer are displayed ✔ When the user chooses the Thumbnail tab ✔ Then the saved part preview is displayed ✔ When the user cancels the properties window without editing ✔ Then the Open dialog is displayed again ✔ And the same part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed
